method: Predeclare one first-use task and public/reviewable ground truth before evaluating a competitor.
Test CoCivium and competitor on consent-compatible matched work, not by scraping personal data or fabricating accounts.
Include the no-special-tool baseline and H0 that incumbent or notebook is better.
Record reviewer independence, disability/mobile conditions, language, test ordering and missing data without personal profiling.
Keep negative results, failures and versioned outcomes. No blanket site-quality score without representative testing.
Recheck official comparator behavior, pricing, availability and terms before procurement or public claims.

umbrella_copy.plain: Useful things you can try, inspect, and improve.
umbrella_copy.explain: The public research is open to improvement; this is not a claim that every website continuously improves autonomously.
umbrella_copy.negative_control: If you cannot do a useful first task and verify a source, the branding is not a substitute.
